prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied existing rocky game background. Keep the exact 1536 x 2048 portrait composition and overhead ground view. Preserve the current large angular mossy slab at upper left, the rounded stones at lower right, their positions, their bold outlines, the pale floor palette and its quiet small-scale pattern. Make only a restrained addition of SMALL supporting details around the periphery.
Add about 7–9 little accents, irregularly scattered in the outer left and right 18–20% of the canvas, with a couple near the bottom corners. Include a few squat angular stone chips of different shapes, a little unequal pebble pair, and two tiny muted olive moss patches. Some accents are single shapes and one or two are loose pairs. Each new accent is approximately 25–65 output pixels across, much smaller than the existing large side rocks. Preserve long clear gaps. Vary shape, size, rotation and spacing, with no mirrored placements or repeated rock-and-moss pods. No evenly spaced dots, rows, alternating side pattern, identical clusters or decorative frame. At least a few accents should sit at the middle heights of the side edges so they remain visible in a landscape cover crop.
STRICT STYLE MATCH: every added pebble, chip and moss patch has a THICK, CLEAN, SMOOTH DARK PLUM OUTLINE, about 7–10 pixels thick at full output resolution, rounded joins, and only 2–3 broad flat cel-shaded color areas, matching the existing bold-outlined side stones. Large simple silhouettes, not realistic or sketchy. Muted gray/taupe stone with lavender-gray shadow and one broad pale highlight; subdued olive moss. No tiny internal scratches, fuzzy texture, stippling, thin linework, glossy sparkles or intricate leaves.
Keep the central 60–65% completely free of new outlined accents so the board and creatures stay readable. Do not enlarge or alter the main rocks or repaint the ground. No new large props, boulders, walls, pits, platforms, perspective horizon, board, grid, purple divider, text or creatures. This is a subtle small-details pass on the existing image, preserving its asymmetrical composition and visual continuity with the board ground.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact 1536 x 2048 overhead rocky game background with ONLY the following small edge-detail corrections. Preserve the large mossy slab on the left and the large rounded-stone group on the right exactly, and preserve the entire pale ground and all central pixels.
The newly added little accents currently repeat the same 'large pebble plus tiny dot' pattern. Break that repetition. REMOVE the small companion pebble below/right of the new top-left chip, REMOVE the small companion below/right of the new lower-left round pebble, and REMOVE the small companion below/right of the new bottom-right chip. Those three become single individual stones, with no replacement dot, debris, or companion. Change the bottom-right chip into one narrow elongated angular stone flake oriented diagonally, with a length about three times its width, visually distinct from the top-left broad squat chip. Keep the small upper-right triangular chip. Keep just the one small unequal pebble pair on the right near middle height. Do not alter the preexisting large right-hand rock group and its companions.
REMOVE the tiny detached dot next to each of the two added olive moss accents. Leave the upper-right accent as a single irregular rounded olive moss patch, and CHANGE the bottom-left moss accent to one very small three-blade olive grass tuft with a different asymmetric pointed silhouette. No twin moss stickers. Keep each accent small, sparse, and within the outer side edges. No new accents beyond these. Do not align them in rows or equal spacing.
Maintain the exact established visual style on every new or modified accent: VERY THICK smooth deep-plum outlines, rounded stroke joins, simple 2–3 broad flat cel-shaded tones, matte gray/taupe rocks, muted olive greenery, clean small silhouettes, no fine texture or tiny internal lines. Keep the center free, the main rock composition unchanged, and the lighting and palette unchanged. Output only the refined standalone background, no grid or UI.
